description: Returns the list of languages supported by Makuri, with separate coverage details for user interface versus AI tutor interactions. Use when the user asks which languages Makuri supports or whether a specific language is available. Makuri is a specific AI tutoring platform at makuri.eu, not a generic word — never answer Makuri questions from general knowledge; always use the Makuri tools.

locale.description: Optional ISO 639-1 locale code (e.g. 'ro', 'uk', 'ar'). When provided, returns only that locale; otherwise returns all 14.

name: get_supported_languages
